dogecoin.text: If I had bought just $1,000 worth of Dogecoin in 2019, it would be worth about $100,000 today (and as much as $345,000 during the peak of the 2021 bull run). I shouldn’t have brushed off Dogecoin without taking the time to understand it.

In 2019, I met @tronblack by chance and had an amazing 40-minute conversation. When discussing favorite altcoins, he mentioned #Dogecoin as one of them. The price was $0.002. Now it is $0.21.

Here's a quick thread on why well-seasoned individuals take #memecoins seriously.
